results.title: Palco Cama
results.overview: Palco cama is an intimate and unprecedented dive into the creative universe of José Celso Martinez Corrêa. Filmed in his bedroom, in his bed—a space of rest, sex, love, dreams, and creation—the playwright transforms everyday life into a scene, making the bed his stage. In an interview that exposes all the raw material, Zé Celso revisits the genesis of his works, narrating with passion and detail the artistic journey that has shaped Brazilian theater. The film captures the raw material of this performative conversation, where the artist performs, reflects, and surrenders himself before the camera, revealing the body and the word as central forces of his art.

results.title: We Can't Leave
results.overview: What starts as a routine audition for a no-name indie horror flick quickly turns deadly when a group of actors find themselves trapped inside a building with no way out. They're hunted by masked killers who know every inch of the building.

results.title: Diorama
results.overview: A young woman recalls a childhood memory of the first signs of her grandmother's Alzheimer's, yet as the narrative unfolds, it becomes evident that all the members of her family share a fear of forgetting the past.

results.title: BACK TO THE BUNKER?
results.overview: The documentary “Back to the Bunker?” tells the story of traumatic bunker experiences in the World Wars, of empty ruins at the turn of the millennium, and of a bunker renaissance in Germany and Europe, based on the personal experiences of contemporary witnesses. An impressive documentary about the culture of remembrance, resilience, and the societal question of how people deal with extreme situations.

results.title: Seduced by His Lies
results.overview: Returning from an extended work trip overseas, Terri arrives home to find a mysterious yet captivating stranger Marcus, living in her recently purchased town home. Both believing they’ve fallen victim to a real estate scam, the duo team up to expose the criminals. Their passionate pursuit for justice sparks a scorching attraction, blurring the lines between desire and danger. As they plunge deeper into the treacherous underworld of the scam, their shared mission evolves into a seductive dance, where the boundaries between vengeance and passion become dangerously entangled. Unbeknownst to her, their relentless investigation exposes a labyrinth of chilling lies that transcends her darkest nightmares. With every twist and turn, suspicion falls on everyone from the conniving realtor to the deceitful lawyer.

results.title: Clean-Up On Aisle Roar
results.overview: A horror-comedy short film about a young woman whose past comes back to haunt her in the produce aisle.

results.title: Tom Green: I Got a Mule!
results.original_title: Tom Green: I Got a Mule!
results.overview: Tom Green shares humorous insights about his experience transitioning from Hollywood to a simpler lifestyle in the countryside. He also provides amusing observations about modern social media pitfalls and other relatable topics.

results.title: Chaos Theory
results.overview: Rick Miller is a hardened and professional detective. However, much to his dismay, he lands a job with the reckless rookie Amy Lovelace. Together they aim to foil an illegal arms deal, with a little luck helping them along the way.

results.title: Hoy extraño
results.overview: Sergio leaves his city to spend a few days at his family home in Asturias. He decides to film the journey there and his solitary and mysterious stay.

results.title: The Pink Pill: Sex, Drugs and Who Has Control
results.original_title: The Pink Pill: Sex, Drugs and Who Has Control
results.overview: A documentary that captures a pivotal moment in the ongoing struggle for complete health care equality, at a time when bodily autonomy hangs in the balance.

results.title: Time We Lost
results.overview: School principal Hans is about to retire, but neither he nor his wife, Rita, are happy about their newly gained free time. For the past 35 years, their marriage has followed a well-established routine, with Rita setting the pace. As far as Rita is concerned, there is no reason to change anything. In fact, she does not like change at all. However, a stroke of fate reopens old wounds and forces them to ask themselves: Are they still a couple, or two separate individuals?

results.title: Woman and Child
results.overview: Mahnaz, a 40-year-old widowed nurse, struggles with her rebellious son, Aliyar, who has been suspended from school. Family tensions reach a peak during the betrothal ceremony with her new boyfriend Hamid, and a tragic accident occurs. In the aftermath, Mahnaz will be forced to confront betrayal and loss, and to embark on a quest for justice.

results.title: Feliz Cumpleaños, Eric
results.overview: At his birthday party, a young introvert must confront his family's conservative ideals when his boyfriend unexpectedly shows up.

results.title: 12 Scissors
results.overview: A murder investigation follows clues given by witnesses and possible suspects, but they are misunderstood. As the police investigation evolves, evidence and witness statements are gathered but accounts of the crime differ. The film explores and develops the main theme around self and how we present or curate ourselves.

results.title: CHIMERA
results.overview: A bookish lab technician uses her access to a DNA database to find a date, but the ‘chance’ meet cute turns into something much more sinister.

results.title: "Origen. La semilla de los tiempos" Teatro de la Maestranza, Seville
results.original_title: "Origen. La semilla de los tiempos" Teatro de la Maestranza, Seville
results.overview: With ‘Origen. La semilla de los tiempos’, the Accademia del Piacere, the Ballet Flamenco de Andalucía and the Teatro de la Maestranza take audiences on a musical dance journey somewhere between tradition and the avant-garde. Baroque music enters into dialogue with flamenco, travelling through the history of Andalusia in a story that gives pride of place to emotion, memory and scenic beauty.

results.title: The Accompanist Awakening
results.overview: Newly engaged lovers Jason and Brandon return to Los Angeles after two years in New York, where Brandon danced with the New York Ballet Company. Jason resumes work as a piano accompanist at a local ballet studio, while Brandon begins teaching ballet. Jason forms a powerful connection with a dancer, Devon, who seeks his help through the rumored magical healing power of his piano music. Brandon’s former abusive partner, Adam, reappears, still in love with him. Haunted by memories of a tragic family accident, Jason struggles to control his music’s power. As desire, magic, and past trauma collide, their love, commitment, and the people they care about are put to the ultimate test.

results.title: Trump's Power & the Rule of Law
results.original_title: Trump's Power & the Rule of Law
results.overview: FRONTLINE goes inside the high-stakes showdown between President Donald Trump and the courts over presidential power. Trump allies, opponents and experts talk about how he is testing the extent of his power; the legal pushback; and the impact on the rule of law.

results.title: Heather
results.overview: Desperate to reignite the spark of creative inspiration that made her a Wunderkind, 29-year-old Heather embarks on a quest for heartache to give her artistic voice as a writer depth and find an idea for her new novel. Heather must discover, that the true heartache lies in not being a Wunderkind anymore, and that it is time to take center stage in her own life.

results.title: Stardom 15th Goddesses of Stardom Tag League ~Opening Match~ in Korakuen
results.original_title: 第15回 ゴッデス・オブ・スターダム ～タッグリーグ開幕戦～ in KORAKUEN
results.overview: 15th Goddesses of Stardom Tag League ~Opening Match~ in Korakuen was a professional wrestling event promoted by World Wonder Ring Stardom. It took place on November 7, 2025, at Korakuen Hall in Tokyo, Japan, and served as the opening show of the tournament's tour.
